summary: Two-pass texture/audio data transformation on a shared buffer. Pass 1, gated by the address value of global unk_602000 (0x602000) being a set bitmask in the flags dword at this+0x60, regenerates engine sound wave tables via EngineSoundWaveTableGenerator and then, when the format byte at this+0x116 equals 3, remaps each pixel's three RGB bytes at the buffer (this+0x104) through a lookup table (this+0x138). Pass 2, gated by flags bit 3 (0x8) at this+0x60 and the same format value 3, computes per-channel shift amounts as 8 minus the amplitude bytes at this+0x150/0x151/0x152, clamps oversize shifts to 0, and right-shifts each pixel's R/G/B channels by those amounts. Both passes iterate the pixel count WORD at this+0x108.

local_names.a1: texture/audio data object; flags at +0x60, buffer pointer at +0x104, count at +0x108, format at +0x116, lookup table at +0x138, channel shifts at +0x150..+0x152
local_names.v2: format indicator byte read from this+0x116; must equal 3 for the pixel loops
local_names.v3: pixel count for the pass-1 lookup remap loop (WORD at this+0x108)
local_names.v4: byte cursor into the buffer starting at *(this+0x104)+2, advancing 3 bytes per pixel
local_names.v5: red channel shift (8 minus byte at this+0x150), clamped to 0 when above 8
local_names.v12: green channel shift (8 minus byte at this+0x151), clamped to 0 when above 8
local_names.v11: blue channel shift (8 minus byte at this+0x152), clamped to 0 when above 8
local_names.v8: pixel count for the pass-2 shift loop (WORD at this+0x108)

operations.description: Read the format indicator byte at this+0x116; a value of 3 is required by both pixel loops.
Pass 1 gate: the address value of unk_602000 (0x602000) is used as a bitmask; when it has any bits set against the flags dword at this+0x60 the pass runs.
Regenerate the engine sound wave tables via EngineSoundWaveTableGenerator, which also supplies the lookup table pointer consumed by the remap pass.
Pass 1 remap runs only when the format byte at this+0x116 equals 3.
Iterate the pixel count WORD at this+0x108; for each pixel remap three consecutive bytes at the buffer pointed to by this+0x104 through the lookup table at this+0x138.
Rewrite the third channel (B) byte of the first pixel at *(this+0x104)+2 with the lookup-table result.
Pass 2 gate: the flags byte at this+0x60 has bit 3 (0x8) set and the format byte at this+0x116 equals 3.
Compute per-channel right-shift amounts as 8 minus the amplitude bytes at this+0x150 (red), this+0x151 (green) and this+0x152 (blue).
Clamp each computed shift amount to 0 when the 8-minus-amplitude value exceeds 8.
Iterate the pixel count WORD at this+0x108; right-shift each pixel's R/G/B channels at the buffer pointed to by this+0x104 by the respective clamped shift amounts.
Legacy ABI label Texture_Image_Color_Transform corroborates the texture color-transformation role.
Invoked by AudioBufferSizeCalc (0x0051868C) to transform audio/texture buffer data.

unresolved: The lookup table at this+0x138 is produced by EngineSoundWaveTableGenerator, but the exact table layout and index domain are not visible in this function.
The meaning of the address of unk_602000 used as a bitmask (pass-1 gate) is a deterministically observed pattern; its semantic flag name is unknown.
Whether the buffer at this+0x104 holds texture pixels, audio samples, or shared data depends on the caller AudioBufferSizeCalc context, not resolvable here.
